required_pr_review.summary: Pullfrog is the sole required exact-head AI review source.
required_pr_review.fallback_summary: Self-managed, Mergeguez, and CodeRabbit review evidence cannot replace exact-head Pullfrog review.

local_validation.summary: All available local gates pass for the exact-head review repair: 198 GitHub helper tests, 48 checksum-verified actionlint and workflow-policy tests, focused scoped-token mint/revoke and retained-output rerun regressions, Python compilation, deterministic workflow materialization, canonical/live byte identity, JSON parsing, exact-delta public-safety and private-data scans, whitespace checks, and official Speculoos validate plus publish-check.

github_checks.summary: PR #95 remains open at exact hosted head 5363904f2b0d1313084c2a76943ad24cf6f9eaa8. Pullfrog completed review 5692731389 with two findings, so pullfrog-approval failed; exact-head Speculoos and provider-free dogfood succeeded. Both findings are repaired locally and require guarded publication plus fresh exact-head hosted checks.

pullfrog_review.summary: Exact-head Pullfrog review 5692731389 found that the Astra fallback could mint the action's broad normal MCP token and that failed-job reruns could invoke Astra more than once for one unchanged identity. The local repair mints one Pullfrog App lease scoped exactly to contents:read plus pull_requests:write, forces the external GH_TOKEN route, requires successful revocation, and prevents provider execution whenever github.run_attempt is not 1 while allowing finalizer-only recovery. Fresh hosted Pullfrog review and approval remain required.

speculoos_evidence.summary: Independent hosted Speculoos evidence passed on 5363904f2b0d1313084c2a76943ad24cf6f9eaa8. Publishing the credential and rerun repairs will create a new exact head, so fresh hosted Speculoos evidence will again be required and cannot be replaced by Pullfrog output.

self_managed.summary: Not accepted as normal or fallback review evidence.

mergeguez_review.summary: Mergeguez is not a reviewer. It remains the manual publication and merge broker; automatic feature-to-dev merge is owned separately by the repository exact-head GitHub Actions gate, while stable-branch merge stays human-authorized.
